methodology: Evidence score = authority 0-30 + directness 0-25 + corroboration 0-20 + recency 0-15 + specificity 0-10 minus uncertainty. Labels: 85-100 Verified, 70-84 Strong, 50-69 Developing, below 50 Early. Forecasts are separated from facts.

records.claim: Texas state agencies were directed to halt new data-center-related state permitting and approvals pending ERCOT power and Texas Water Development Board water audits; TCEQ compliance reporting was due October 19.
records.why_it_matters: Creates a statewide permitting constraint tied directly to grid and water capacity.
records.label: Verified

records.claim: California signed a seven-bill data-center package covering grid and water upgrade cost allocation, water-use and drought disclosures, energy procurement, siting/resource-use requirements, and conditions for streamlined environmental review.
records.why_it_matters: Changes the regulatory and cost-allocation environment for California data-center development.
records.label: Verified

records.claim: Nineteen additional organizations joined Canada's Responsible Data Centre Development Principles, bringing participation from 23 to 42 organizations; the principles address ratepayer protection, water, transparency, and local benefits and remain voluntary.
records.why_it_matters: Broadens industry participation in a national framework that could influence later binding policy.
records.label: Strong

records.claim: Maryland Executive Order 01.01.2026.16 subjects proposed data centers with at least 25 MW peak demand, including 25-MW expansions, to a statewide accountability framework and project classification process.
records.why_it_matters: State classifications can affect permits, incentives and expedited coordination.
records.label: Verified

records.claim: Cipher amended Fluidstack's Barber Lake lease and disclosed a binding commitment from an undisclosed AI lab for a subsequent 10-year lease, extending aggregate contracted term to 20 years and expected contracted revenue to more than $9 billion.
records.why_it_matters: Materially increases contracted economics and AI demand visibility for the campus.
records.label: Verified

records.claim: ODATA began installing and testing Aligned's DeltaFlow liquid-cooling system at QR03 for high-density AI workloads using a hybrid closed-loop design intended to avoid operational cooling-water consumption.
records.why_it_matters: Provides a concrete high-density AI cooling deployment in a water-constrained data-center market.
records.label: Strong

records.claim: WEG announced a $165 million North American generator-manufacturing expansion; phase one allocates $24 million to a Mexican assembly plant scheduled to begin operating in Q2 2027.
records.why_it_matters: Data-center power demand is driving regional manufacturing investment in critical-power equipment.
records.label: Verified

records.claim: HiRef broke ground on its first manufacturing plant in the Americas, backed by an initial investment exceeding MXN200 million, to produce precision cooling, chillers and liquid-cooling systems.
records.why_it_matters: Localizes production for a critical high-density AI infrastructure bottleneck.
records.label: Strong

records.claim: PJM began reviewing large-load adjustments submitted by 12 utilities for its 2027 Long-Term Load Forecast; most requests involve data centers and new rules seek evidence of contract status, construction commitments and duplicated requests.
records.why_it_matters: Could filter speculative data-center load from transmission and generation planning.
records.label: Verified

records.claim: Exus Renewables acquired four solar projects totaling 715 MW and said it was negotiating PPAs with hyperscalers and utilities serving data-center loads.
records.why_it_matters: Grid-advanced generation assets are being positioned directly against rising data-center demand.
records.label: Verified

records.claim: BUZZ HPC is considering a 320-MW, privately financed campus exceeding C$3.5 billion on a 25-acre Ninth Line property it has purchased; no formal planning application had been submitted.
records.why_it_matters: Would be a major Canadian sovereign-compute campus requiring provincial-scale electrical infrastructure.
records.label: Developing

records.claim: Amazon and Constellation signed a 20-year agreement covering 690 MW, including a planned 190-MW expansion of Calvert Cliffs nuclear generation.
records.why_it_matters: A hyperscaler is underwriting additional grid-connected nuclear capacity rather than only reserving existing output.
records.label: Verified

records.claim: The Senate voted 57-43 to advance the Ratepayer Protection Act, short of the required threshold after the House had approved it 417-3.
records.why_it_matters: This bill did not create a federal data-center cost-allocation standard, leaving the issue to other federal proposals and state utility proceedings.
records.label: Verified

records.market: Calgary-based supplier / undisclosed North American project
records.claim: Enerflex received a contract to design and assemble approximately 450 MW of natural-gas generation for an undisclosed North American data-center developer and authorized about $85 million of manufacturing-capacity investment.
records.why_it_matters: Demonstrates contracted utility-scale onsite generation being used to address data-center power constraints.
records.label: Strong

records.claim: Enverus forecast 31.6 GW of new industrial behind-the-meter generation through 2030, including 29.6 GW of gas capacity; data centers account for 22.5 GW in the forecast.
records.why_it_matters: Shows how grid delays could shift data-center power demand toward onsite generation; this is a forecast, not realized capacity.
records.label: Strong
